name: Health Library Support 2026 (HealthKit and Health Connect types each wrapper library maps)
methodology: For each of 11 React Native, Capacitor, Cordova and Flutter wrappers of HealthKit and Health Connect tracked on this site, the files that map the library's own data-type names onto the platform's (a permission switch, a type dictionary, a TypeScript union of identifier strings, an import list; named per library in the library's page) were read from raw.githubusercontent.com on 2026-11-19, at the commit of the release tag that names the registry's latest version, or at the default branch head where no tag does (refKind). Every HealthKit identifier (HKQuantityTypeIdentifier, HKCategoryTypeIdentifier, HKCharacteristicTypeIdentifier or HKCorrelationTypeIdentifier, as an Objective-C constant, a string or a Swift case) and every Health Connect record class those files name outside a comment is one row, with the file, line and verbatim line. match is exact when the token is, character for character, an identifier in this site's HealthKit identifier dataset or a class in its Health Connect records dataset, and unmatched otherwise (correlation types, which those datasets do not cover, and types newer than them); nothing is matched by similarity. A row says the library's mapping files name the type; it is not a test of the call at runtime. Left out: expo-health-connect (An Expo config plugin for react-native-health-connect: it edits the Android project and maps no data type itself, so its coverage is react-native-health-connect's.); react-native-google-fit (Wraps the Google Fit APIs, neither HealthKit nor Health Connect (libraries.ts records its registry description as naming Google Fit only).).
generatedFrom: src/data/healthLibrarySupport.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-health-library-support.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.library: The library's slug on this site (/libraries/<slug>)
fields.refKind: tag when a release tag names the registry's latest version, head when none does and the default branch was read
fields.tag: That tag; null for a head read
fields.registryVersion: The registry's latest version when this site last read the registry
fields.sourceVersion: The version the package manifest states at that commit
fields.match: exact when the token is an identifier in this site's lists, unmatched otherwise
fields.id: HealthKit: the Objective-C constant; Health Connect: the record class (exact rows only)
fields.name: HealthKit: the Swift case; Health Connect: the record class (exact rows only)
fields.family: quantity, category or characteristic for HealthKit; record for Health Connect (exact rows only)
fields.token: The text the pattern matched on the line
fields.line: The first line in the read files that names it
fields.source: That line on GitHub at the commit read
fields.occurrences: How many lines in the read files name it
fields.page: The library's page on this site
